description: Datasets added, changed or removed in the index since a date, and datasets whose portal says they were updated since then. Optional portal filter. For changes to this server itself (new tools, fixes, corrections), use whats_changed instead.

limit.description: Most rows in each list. Default 50

portal.description: source_id, registry_id (every site of that government) or part of a portal name

name: whats_new
